definition: lambda = time-avg log|a_t*(1-2h_{t-1})| along the task's own h-orbit (h_0=0.5, iid drivers, task clip applied)
verdict: lambda = -0.2012 < 0: the system is CONTRACTIVE on average (4/5 drivers are period-1/2 attractors; the sole chaotic driver a=3.6 has fixed-driver lambda = +0.183, but the mixed-driver average is negative). T* = ln(1/eps)/lambda is therefore NOT a finite kill length on this family: state error DECAYS rather than compounds. This matches the paper's section-6 contractive-control finding and is why this family is the 8M control, not the 1.3B depth-wall test vehicle (operator ruling taskA3-D2).
